headline: Our Services
sub: Three services built for different programs and goals. Read through, find what fits your program, and go from there.

services.title: Team & Individual Photo Day
services.sub: The Foundation of What We Do
services.desc: We come to you. No cost to your organization — families pay for what they want through a secure online gallery. Works for any sport, any level, any roster size.

services.title: Pro Banners
services.desc: Individual athlete banners, traditional team banners, and full composite designs. 3–7 business day production. Bulk pricing available for 4+ banners.

services.title: Phireworx Media Day Experience
services.desc: One flat rate. Paid by the program. Every photo from the shoot goes directly to your team — no packages, no ordering, no waiting. Advanced lighting, smoke, dramatic setups.

compare_section.headline: Not Sure Which One?
compare_section.sub: A quick comparison to help you figure out which service fits your program best.
